summary: A person who is not the listed voter stands in the sun and talks with the canvasser for most of an hour about school and why a vote hardly matters.
realLife: A canvasser in California talked about forty minutes with a farm mechanic who was not the listed voter and doubted votes counted.
sources: San Francisco Chronicle, canvassing in California's Central Valley, undated: https://preview-prod.w.sfchronicle.com/politics/article/canvassing-california-central-valley-19852147.php
inGame: resident's views record (distrust of voting, children's schooling); not the listed voter

turns.turn: The talk runs long and the canvasser loses the rest of the street
turns.pulledBy: an open resident with a grievance
turns.writesBack: the shift record shows few doors, one long talk

turns.turn: The canvasser ends it kindly and asks him to tell his grown children
